Write a [full-time / part-time / contractor] offer letter for [candidate name] for the position of [job title] at [your company name].
Details:
- Start date: [date]
- Compensation: [salary/rate]
- Schedule: [full-time, part-time, hours/week]
- Location: [remote / hybrid / on-site]
- Reporting to: [name/title]
- Benefits: [list — PTO, health, equipment, etc.]
- Equity/bonus: [if applicable]
- Probation period: [if applicable]
- At-will employment: [yes/no]
Tone: warm and professional — this should make them excited to accept. Include a brief welcome paragraph about why we're thrilled to have them, the formal terms, and clear acceptance instructions (sign and return by [date]). Mention any onboarding steps or what to expect on Day 1.
